--- Page 1 (Beckerman_17a) --- Dear Folks, Ruth: Rec'd your letter of 7 Feb. yesterday. A long one of your pages which I enjoyed very much. Glad you're enjoying all those pictures, papers, etc. This morning I wrapped a little packages containing newspapers, magazines, and a lot of miscellaneous papers that I have been meaning to send to you. This was a good chance to clean my drawers of all the papers and what not that I was saving for you. Now you'll get them all in the load. Should be arriving about 2 mo. We've had a good addition to the "Travel files". You mention not hearing from Alice for a time. You probably have heard something "and him" by this time. Has almost forgotten about some of the things you asked in your last letter. Concerning the fish, Reena's visits, Sam's visits. While I could send [illegible] in. I literally [illegible] me will --- Page 2 (Beckerman_17b) --- 2 overloaded with them. We draw a ration of four cartons a month. But I don't smoke that many so I usually wind up in giving some away! It's amazing to realize that without tax charges they only cost us about 50¢ a carton or 15¢ per pack. Talking of Abe's picture. The 13th Air Force is operating around the Philippines I think; so that may have been him after all. Boy, talk of $ now is wonderful. Hope I get a chance to see some of it one of these years. Our last wealth has almost left us. This afternoon (Sun) we're planning to take a boat ride up the Brisbane River to an island called a Karaka - never seen one before it's saucy. I may inty. That's all for now - things still OK Yours Jack
